slides.title: Tostatura: what roast does to coffee
slides.subtitle: The word on the bag shapes your cup.

slides.title: Tostatura means roasting
slides.body: Coffee beans start out green and hard. Roasting heats them until they turn brown and develop the aromas you know as coffee.
slides.highlight: Same bean, different roast, different cup.

slides.title: Medium sits in between
slides.body: Medium roasts usually balance acidity with a fuller body. If you're unsure which to pick, start here and adjust.
slides.highlight: Not too bright, not too bold.

slides.label: The tip
slides.body: Roast names aren't standardized. One roaster's medium can be another's dark, so taste first and trust your cup over the label.

slides.title: Roast sets the flavor of your cup
slides.body: Light is brighter, dark is bolder, medium sits between.
slides.cta: Save this for your next bag
